 THIS MFA IS FILED U/S.173(1) OF MV ACT, AGAINST THE JUDGMENT AND AWARD DATED.28.07.2018 PASSED IN MVC NO.175/2018 ON THE FILE OF THE SENIOR CIVIL JUDGE, MACT,
CHANNAGIRI, PARTLY ALLOWING THE CLAIM PETITION FOR COMPENSATION AND SEEKING ENHANCEMENT OF COMPENSATION.

THIS APPEAL, COMING ON FOR FURTHER ORDERS, THIS DAY, THE COURT DELIVERED THE FOLLOWING:
 JUDGMENT

The claimant is appealing the Judgment and Award dated July 28, 2018, passed by the Senior Civil Judge and MACT at Channagiri in MVC No.175/2018.
2.
The claimant, having sustained injuries in a road traffic accident, filed a petition under Section 166 of the Motor Vehicles Act.
The Tribunal awarded compensation of Rs.1,10,000/- with interest at the rate of 6% per annum, from the date of the petition until realization.
The claimant has hence appealed for an enhancement of the compensation awarded.

3. Heard the arguments of the learned counsel for the appellant and the learned counsel for the respondent/Insurance Company, and perused the records.
4.
The accident occurred in 2017 when the claimant was about 11 years old.
In the road traffic accident, she suffered a NC: 2024:KHC:20504 fracture of the left tibia and other injuries.

Exhibit P5 is the wound certificate indicating that the claimant sustained an irregularly shaped abrasion measuring 3 x 2 cm over the left leg and an irregularly shaped abrasion measuring 16 x 5 cm over Pallavi vs Sri. Dananjaya J.C on 11 June, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/129723450/
2
the left ankle and foot.
5. The appellant/claimant did not examine a doctor to assess any potential permanent disability.
However, the claimant was an inpatient for 11 days.

Considering the nature of the injuries sustained by the claimant and the fact that she was 11 years old at the time of the accident, it is deemed appropriate to award an enhanced compensation of Rs.40,000/-, in addition to the Rs.1,10,000/-
already awarded by the Tribunal.
6.
The claimant is entitled to this additional compensation of Rs.40,000/-, which shall also carry interest at the rate of 6% per annum, from the date of the petition until realization.

To this extent,
the impugned award stands modified.
7. Accordingly, the appeal is allowed in part.
The enhanced compensation is to be deposited by respondent No.2/Insurance Company within three months from the date of receipt of a copy of this order.
